Proof. We reduce from HAMILTONIAN CYCLE, known to be NP-complete even for planar cubic bipartite graphs [18]. Given a planar cubic bipartite graph \(G\), we apply a hexagon implant to a vertex \(u \in V(G)\) (see Figure 4) and we set \(e = u'z\). Clearly, the resulting graph \(G'\) is planar, cubic and bipartite. Moreover, \(G'\) contains a Hamiltonian cycle through \(e\) if and only if \(G\) contains a Hamiltonian cycle.
